name: Pelvic Ring Fracture
definition: Fracture or ligamentous disruption of the pelvic ring, ranging from stable fragility injury to unstable high-energy trauma with hemorrhage risk.

investigations.principle: CT is central in major trauma; MRI can detect occult fragility injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Unstable injuries may require fixation, embolization and multidisciplinary trauma care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna management may support recovery only after stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture or ligamentous disruption of the pelvic ring, ranging from stable fragility injury to unstable high-energy trauma with hemorrhage risk.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
